jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Quote to Order
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Business Process Manager

We Are Hiring 3 Implementation Managers To Drive Our Global Quote-to-Order Transformation. You Will Join a Key Initiative To Standardize Commercial Processes And Digital Solutions Across Our Business. Apply For The Region That Matches Your Profile And Career Aspirations

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Compensation Package

For candidates applying from Italy:

As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to share the compensation details for this position:

Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico

Minimum annual salary: €53.000

Variable Pay: AIP target % + Eligible for Company Productivity Bonus

Country-specific benefits will be discussed with shortlisted candidates based on location.

The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Benefits As Per Policy

Flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and a strong focus on work-life integration and Wellbeing support for employees and their families

Welfare plan with a wide range of personalized services

Canteen or meal vouchers provided

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

to lead AI projects for our clients from first idea to production.
As part of our dynamic team, you will be the link between our clients, our engineers and the AI technologies we build with. You will scope projects, steer delivery and make sure what we ship creates real value in Swiss companies across a wide range of industries.

ParetoLabs is a Zurich-based software studio that develops customized, AI-powered applications for conversational and text-processing use cases. We help companies quickly test, implement, and scale AI applications within their specific business environments.
Founded in 2023, ParetoLabs is a Microsoft for Startups partner that combines innovative AI technologies with the individual requirements of Swiss companies.
Tasks

Lead AI projects end to end — retrieval assistants, copilots and agents — from discovery and scoping to rollout and operation.
Translate business problems into clear use cases, requirements and success criteria together with our clients.
Plan and steer delivery with our engineering team: scope, timeline, budget, risks and priorities.
Define how quality is measured and make sure solutions are evaluated before and after go-live.
Work with client stakeholders on data, security, compliance and change management.
Collaborate closely with our multicultural team and bring your own ideas to projects with real-world impact.

Requirements

Experience:
Several years of project management in software, data or digital transformation projects; AI or data projects are a strong plus.

A solid grasp of how large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agents work, what they are good at and where they fail.
Technical Foundation:
Enough understanding of software architecture and cloud infrastructure (ideally Microsoft Azure) to discuss solutions with engineers and client IT and security teams.
Methods:
Confident with agile delivery and with structuring ambiguous problems into concrete plans.

Experience working with business and IT stakeholders up to management level, including managing expectations about what AI can and cannot do.

Awareness of data protection (Swiss FADP, GDPR) and information security in client projects.

Excellent German and English, written and spoken.

Structured, hands-on and curious, with the ownership to bring projects over the finish line.

A competitive salary package, reflecting your experience and contributions.

Choose your preferred devices for work.

above market pension benefits and a private accident insurance.

Participation in the Microsoft for Startups program, offering access to valuable resources, events and support.

jobs.description:
What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you?

When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Our associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training and career development — as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team, Gartner is where you want to be.

About this role:

The Global S&O arm of Gartner is currently seeking talented people to join its Client Engagement Service (CES) team in India. As a member of this team you will drive client engagement and service productivity programs across Gartner. You will work towards driving integrated approach across Gartner’s key functions – Business units under Global Service & Delivery (GS&D), Sales, BTI and Products and their leaders with the central goal of improving client retention through high value engagement mechanisms. You will also get an opportunity to work on some of the high impact workstreams to drive key organizational, service associates & team level engagement goals.

What you’ll do: 

The CES Engagement Campaigns Team
is responsible for driving client engagement across Gartner offerings, including Gartner research content, conferences, virtual events, and other high-value client programs through targeted outreach campaigns. This role sits at the intersection of campaign operations, analytics, and stakeholder enablement, with a strong focus on delivering meaningful client interactions at scale. The team closely partners with Services, Conferences, Marketing, and Platform teams to develop targeted outreach strategies, improve campaign performance, and deliver actionable insights that help advance CES business priorities with an ultimate focus on increasing client engagement, adoption, and retention.

Core Operations

Own end-to-end execution of client engagement campaigns across assigned products, practices, and business units.
Build and deploy targeted email campaigns, including audience selection, content curation, template creation, testing, and launch.
Partner with stakeholders to define campaign goals, messaging, and target client segments.
Continuously enhance campaign templates and outreach journeys to improve engagement and conversion.
Ensure operational excellence through rigorous quality checks and campaign governance.

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

Track and analyze campaign performance metrics such as opens, clicks, engagement, and conversion rates.
Use data and A/B testing to identify opportunities and improve campaign effectiveness.
Identify engagement trends, uncover gaps, and generate actionable insights to drive client outreach strategies.
Streamline processes, implement best practices, and leverage automation to improve efficiency and scalability.
Share performance insights, key learnings, and recommendations during operational review forums.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Enable stakeholders with dashboards, reports, and insights that support engagement tracking and decision-making.
Act as a trusted partner by managing campaign-related requests, providing analysis, and recommending actions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and execute initiatives that increase client engagement.
Communicate campaign outcomes and strategic recommendations to influence stakeholder decisions and priorities.

What you’ll need:

MBA with 0-4 years of work experience
Strong leadership skills to build capability within the team and collaborate with other team leads to ensure the larger goals are met
Good command of knowledge related to Information technology, product development and its application to business
Knowledge/experience on analytical problem solving, analytical tools
Exposure and understanding of lean six sigma, lean diagnostics, T&M and other process improvement techniques would be a big plus

Who you are:

Developing professionals with strong business acumen, problem solving leadership (qualitative & quantitative).
High on champion mindset and a quick learner
Strong orientation towards operational and business excellence
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Innovative mindset and inclination to solve business problems
Analytical thinker with experience deriving business insights from data analytics
Detail-oriented with high personal standard for quality
Comfortable in working with cross-functional teams
Skillful in managing expectations of varying stakeholders (internal & external)

What we offer:

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:

Competitive base salary
Flexible work environment
A great work culture

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Query, transform, and analyze data from enterprise data sources, including Snowflake.

Applies analytical rigor to define outcome measures, improve prioritization, increase agility in decisioning, improve ability to evaluate progress towards business outcomes, and to evaluate risks to strategic goals.

Demonstrated experience using data analytics to formulate data-driven insights and influence business decisions.
Experience performing complex data analysis using various data analytics tools (i.e. Microsoft Excel, Tableau, R, Python, SQL, Snowflake, SAS, Adobe Analytics).
Demonstrated experience in project management.

What Sets You Apart

Bachelor's Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Business, Information Systems, Marketing Analytics, or a related discipline.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Adobe Analytics or similar digital analytics platforms.
Strong experience querying, transforming, and analyzing data using SQL.
Experience working with Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms.
Experience working with User data – Fullstory, Glassbox, Qualtrics
Proven ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience presenting analytical findings and insights to business leaders and stakeholders.
Knowledge of digital marketing, digital acquisition, customer experience, or web analytics.
Experience defining and implementing performance metrics, KPIs, and reporting frameworks.
Understanding of customer journey analysis and digital engagement measurement.
Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams, including business partners, product owners, and technology teams.
Experience training or coaching business users on reporting tools and data interpretation.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Data Analytics and Reporting Analyst to support Digital Acquisition Analytics through the development of reporting solutions, performance analysis, and actionable business insights. You will be an expert in Adobe Analytics and how to connect with offline sources to translate digital experience to ultimate outcomes. By building the foundation and creating dashboards and insights that will empower our Product Managers and Owners to manage digital product more effectively.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and reporting skills, experience working with digital analytics platforms, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights for business partners. This individual will collaborate closely with Digital Acquisition teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand reporting needs, develop performance metrics, and drive data-informed decision making.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site four days per week.

What You'll Do

Develop, maintain, and enhance Adobe Analytics dashboards and front-end reporting solutions.
Ensure reporting accuracy, data integrity, and alignment with business requirements.
Query, transform, and analyze data from enterprise data sources, including Snowflake.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify performance trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations that support business strategy and performance goals.
Present findings and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership.
Applies analytical rigor to define outcome measures, improve prioritization, increase agility in decisioning, improve ability to evaluate progress towards business outcomes, and to evaluate risks to strategic goals.
Train and support stakeholders on report interpretation and data-driven decision-making.
Partner with Digital Acquisition teams to understand evolving reporting needs and business objectives.
Develop a deep understanding of customer journeys, digital experiences, and performance touchpoints to improve overall customer outcomes.

What You Have

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Science, Finance, Economics or related field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
Minimum 6 years’ data and/or analytics or strategy consulting experience OR a minimum of 4 years’ data and/or analytics or strategy consulting experience and up to 2 years’ progressive functional business relevant experience for a total of 6 years combined experience OR Advanced Degree in Business, Science, Finance, Economics or related discipline and 4 years’ experience in data and/or analytics or strategy consulting.
Experience identifying business needs and managing strategic plans driven by qualitative/quantitative analysis and market insights.
Demonstrated experience using data analytics to formulate data-driven insights and influence business decisions.
Experience performing complex data analysis using various data analytics tools (i.e. Microsoft Excel, Tableau, R, Python, SQL, Snowflake, SAS, Adobe Analytics).
Demonstrated experience in project management.

What Sets You Apart

Bachelor's Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Business, Information Systems, Marketing Analytics, or a related discipline.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Adobe Analytics or similar digital analytics platforms.
Strong experience querying, transforming, and analyzing data using SQL.
Experience working with Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms.
Experience working with User data – Fullstory, Glassbox, Qualtrics
Proven ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience presenting analytical findings and insights to business leaders and stakeholders.
Knowledge of digital marketing, digital acquisition, customer experience, or web analytics.
Experience defining and implementing performance metrics, KPIs, and reporting frameworks.
Understanding of customer journey analysis and digital engagement measurement.
Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams, including business partners, product owners, and technology teams.
Experience training or coaching business users on reporting tools and data interpretation.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

jobs.title: Principal Consultant, Senior Environmental Project Manager (Planning & Permitting)
jobs.description:
Lead the Future of Energy Development Across the Gulf Region

Are you a strategic environmental leader ready to influence the next generation of energy infrastructure projects? ERM
is seeking a Principal Consultant, Senior Environmental Project Manager (Permitting and Impact Assessor)
to join our team in Houston, TX, Austin, Tx, and Dallas, Tx
. In this highly visible leadership role, you will help clients navigate complex environmental and regulatory challenges while advancing critical traditional, renewable, and low-carbon energy projects.

This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, client leadership, and commercial growth in a role that directly shapes sustainable development outcomes and supports the future of the energy sector.

Why This Role Matters

As the energy sector continues to evolve, organizations are facing increasingly complex permitting, regulatory, and environmental requirements. ERM partners with leading energy clients to deliver innovative, sustainable solutions that help move critical projects forward responsibly and efficiently.

As a Principal Consultant, you will play a key role in guiding major energy developments from concept to execution, helping clients navigate regulatory landscapes, reduce project risk, and achieve successful environmental outcomes. Your expertise will directly contribute to the delivery of transformative infrastructure projects while supporting ERM's continued growth and leadership in the energy market. This role also offers a clear pathway toward future leadership opportunities, including Partner and Technical Director career tracks.

What Your Impact Is

Strategic Leadership: Guide clients through siting, permitting, and environmental impact assessments for major energy projects.
Client Growth: Expand ERM's footprint by leveraging your industry relationships and commercial acumen.
Project Excellence: Deliver high-quality, compliant, and timely outcomes across diverse energy portfolios, from pipelines to offshore wind developments.
Team Development: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
Sustainable Outcomes: Support the responsible development of traditional, renewable, and low-carbon energy infrastructure projects that create long-term value for clients and communities.

Required

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
6+ years of consulting or energy sector experience (10+ years preferred).
Proven success in project management and client relationship development.
Expertise in local, state, and federal permitting (e.g., USACE, FERC, USFWS).
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively in both technical and commercial settings.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while leading teams and project delivery efforts effectively.
Driver's License Required: This position requires a valid driver's license and/or the ability to operate a company vehicle due to the nature of job duties, which include frequent travel to various client locations across a large geographical area.

Preferred

NEPA and ESHIA experience.
Established reputation and professional network within the Gulf Coast energy market.
Experience supporting low-carbon and renewable energy projects.
Previous line management and/or mentorship experience.
Interest in pursuing future Partner or Technical Director career opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as Project Manager on complex, multidisciplinary projects and programs.
Lead permitting and environmental impact assessment efforts for capital energy projects across traditional and renewable energy sectors.
Lead multi-media permitting for capital projects, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, including oversight from agencies such as the USACE, USFWS, and FERC.
Build, strengthen, and maintain trusted client relationships through technical excellence and strategic advisory support.
Collaborate with ERM leadership and account teams to drive commercial growth and expand client partnerships.
Contribute to go-to-market strategies and business development initiatives.
Deliver high-quality technical work products while ensuring regulatory compliance and project success.
Support team development through coaching, mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to ERM's inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture.

Who We Are:

As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.

Please submit your resume and brief cover letter.

Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Data Analytics and Reporting Analyst to support Digital Acquisition Analytics through the development of reporting solutions, performance analysis, and actionable business insights. You will be an expert in Adobe Analytics and how to connect with offline sources to translate digital experience to ultimate outcomes. By building the foundation and creating dashboards and insights that will empower our Product Managers and Owners to manage digital product more effectively.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and reporting skills, experience working with digital analytics platforms, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights for business partners. This individual will collaborate closely with Digital Acquisition teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand reporting needs, develop performance metrics, and drive data-informed decision making.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site four days per week.

What You'll Do

Develop, maintain, and enhance Adobe Analytics dashboards and front-end reporting solutions.
Ensure reporting accuracy, data integrity, and alignment with business requirements.
Query, transform, and analyze data from enterprise data sources, including Snowflake.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify performance trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations that support business strategy and performance goals.
Present findings and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership.
Applies analytical rigor to define outcome measures, improve prioritization, increase agility in decisioning, improve ability to evaluate progress towards business outcomes, and to evaluate risks to strategic goals.
Train and support stakeholders on report interpretation and data-driven decision-making.
Partner with Digital Acquisition teams to understand evolving reporting needs and business objectives.
Develop a deep understanding of customer journeys, digital experiences, and performance touchpoints to improve overall customer outcomes.

What You Have

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Science, Finance, Economics or related field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
Minimum 6 years’ data and/or analytics or strategy consulting experience OR a minimum of 4 years’ data and/or analytics or strategy consulting experience and up to 2 years’ progressive functional business relevant experience for a total of 6 years combined experience OR Advanced Degree in Business, Science, Finance, Economics or related discipline and 4 years’ experience in data and/or analytics or strategy consulting.
Experience identifying business needs and managing strategic plans driven by qualitative/quantitative analysis and market insights.
Demonstrated experience using data analytics to formulate data-driven insights and influence business decisions.
Experience performing complex data analysis using various data analytics tools (i.e. Microsoft Excel, Tableau, R, Python, SQL, Snowflake, SAS, Adobe Analytics).
Demonstrated experience in project management.

What Sets You Apart

Bachelor's Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Business, Information Systems, Marketing Analytics, or a related discipline.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Adobe Analytics or similar digital analytics platforms.
Strong experience querying, transforming, and analyzing data using SQL.
Experience working with Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms.
Experience working with User data – Fullstory, Glassbox, Qualtrics
Proven ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience presenting analytical findings and insights to business leaders and stakeholders.
Knowledge of digital marketing, digital acquisition, customer experience, or web analytics.
Experience defining and implementing performance metrics, KPIs, and reporting frameworks.
Understanding of customer journey analysis and digital engagement measurement.
Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams, including business partners, product owners, and technology teams.
Experience training or coaching business users on reporting tools and data interpretation.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

new_jobs.description:
Overview i3 is searching for a Senior Operations Research Analyst to join our team. Responsibilities * Candidate will serve as the Sr Operations Research Analyst to an Army Product Office responsible for the development and defense of cost estimates to support acquisition decision-making. * Candidate will plan, coordinate, and conduct independent cost analysis for the assigned program ensuring technical appropriateness, soundness, and accurate interpretation of results with regard to cost and budget. * Perform the calculation and forecasting of the future costs of systems, projects/programs, resources, to support independent studies, funding decisions, and various management reviews (e.g., milestone reviews, budget reviews). * Create and maintain lifecycle cost estimates in ACE-IT. * Develop cost estimating methodologies based on available data sources. * Perform the planning and development of controls and provide expert technical analyses, budgetary advice, and guidance regarding the development and implementation of resource allocations and plans in order to defend budget activities. * Conduct analysis and provide recommendations by applying expert knowledge of a broad range of cost analysis strategies to include mathematics, statistical analysis, parametric and non-parametric analysis, computer modeling, regression analysis, and economic analysis. * Coordinate with the PAE FIRES and PM IFMC Program Office Estimates for APBs and other milestone review documentation. * Create documents and briefing charts that communicate current status and forecast on program with regard to cost. * Receive and analyze Earned Value Management reports and make recommendations to Product Manager based on analysis. Qualifications * A bachelors degree in mathematics, statistics, or Operations Research is desired.

10+ years of relevant work experience is desired.
History of supporting and engaging executive level leadership.
High understanding of MS Office suite and ACE-IT cost modeling experience is required.
Knowledge of US Army acquisition processes and experience working and closing actions/taskers that are briefed to higher headquarters and executive leadership.
The successful candidate will be highly organized, flexible and must demonstrate attention to detail and the ability to meet suspense’s.
Candidate must be able to work with minimum guidance in addressing actions, and then use their own knowledge, ingenuity, innovation and experience to complete the product.
Excellent written and verbal communication’s skills, people skills and enthusiasm are important, as well as the ability to handle a variety of tasks in a team environment.
Candidate must be a resident of Huntsville, Alabama or be willing to relocate to the Huntsville, Alabama area.
Position requires an active Secret Security Clearance. About i3 Founded in 2007, Integration Innovation, Inc. (i3) is headquartered in Huntsville, AL, with additional offices in Orlando, FL, and the National Capital Region. We are a 100% team member-owned mid-tier integrator with over 800 employee-owners, and our culture speaks for itself: we've earned ten Best Places to Work® awards, driven by strong employee engagement, transparent leadership, and a genuine commitment to communication. i3 team members operate at the leading edge of national defense across a broad range of technical disciplines, from systems and software engineering to modeling, simulation, and training solutions to cybersecurity, digital engineering, and enterprise IT. We also take products from prototype through production, bringing that same engineering rigor to manufacturing and delivering hardware at scale. For candidates, that means a rare opportunity: the innovation and mission focus of an engineering services company paired with the hands-on impact of building and delivering real solutions that benefit the Warfighter, all inside an employee-owned company where your contributions directly shape both the mission and your ownership stake in the business.

new_jobs.description:
Lead the Future of Energy Development Across the Gulf Region

Are you a strategic environmental leader ready to influence the next generation of energy infrastructure projects? ERM
is seeking a Principal Consultant, Senior Environmental Project Manager (Permitting and Impact Assessor)
to join our team in Houston, TX, Austin, Tx, and Dallas, Tx
. In this highly visible leadership role, you will help clients navigate complex environmental and regulatory challenges while advancing critical traditional, renewable, and low-carbon energy projects.

This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, client leadership, and commercial growth in a role that directly shapes sustainable development outcomes and supports the future of the energy sector.

Why This Role Matters

As the energy sector continues to evolve, organizations are facing increasingly complex permitting, regulatory, and environmental requirements. ERM partners with leading energy clients to deliver innovative, sustainable solutions that help move critical projects forward responsibly and efficiently.

As a Principal Consultant, you will play a key role in guiding major energy developments from concept to execution, helping clients navigate regulatory landscapes, reduce project risk, and achieve successful environmental outcomes. Your expertise will directly contribute to the delivery of transformative infrastructure projects while supporting ERM's continued growth and leadership in the energy market. This role also offers a clear pathway toward future leadership opportunities, including Partner and Technical Director career tracks.

What Your Impact Is

Strategic Leadership: Guide clients through siting, permitting, and environmental impact assessments for major energy projects.
Client Growth: Expand ERM's footprint by leveraging your industry relationships and commercial acumen.
Project Excellence: Deliver high-quality, compliant, and timely outcomes across diverse energy portfolios, from pipelines to offshore wind developments.
Team Development: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
Sustainable Outcomes: Support the responsible development of traditional, renewable, and low-carbon energy infrastructure projects that create long-term value for clients and communities.

Required

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
6+ years of consulting or energy sector experience (10+ years preferred).
Proven success in project management and client relationship development.
Expertise in local, state, and federal permitting (e.g., USACE, FERC, USFWS).
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively in both technical and commercial settings.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while leading teams and project delivery efforts effectively.
Driver's License Required: This position requires a valid driver's license and/or the ability to operate a company vehicle due to the nature of job duties, which include frequent travel to various client locations across a large geographical area.

Preferred

NEPA and ESHIA experience.
Established reputation and professional network within the Gulf Coast energy market.
Experience supporting low-carbon and renewable energy projects.
Previous line management and/or mentorship experience.
Interest in pursuing future Partner or Technical Director career opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as Project Manager on complex, multidisciplinary projects and programs.
Lead permitting and environmental impact assessment efforts for capital energy projects across traditional and renewable energy sectors.
Lead multi-media permitting for capital projects, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, including oversight from agencies such as the USACE, USFWS, and FERC.
Build, strengthen, and maintain trusted client relationships through technical excellence and strategic advisory support.
Collaborate with ERM leadership and account teams to drive commercial growth and expand client partnerships.
Contribute to go-to-market strategies and business development initiatives.
Deliver high-quality technical work products while ensuring regulatory compliance and project success.
Support team development through coaching, mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to ERM's inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture.

Who We Are:

As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.

Please submit your resume and brief cover letter.

ERM does not accept recruiting agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ERM employees or any other company location. ERM is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

new_jobs.description:
About Skyne Beauty

Skyne Beauty is a San Francisco-based K-beauty brand focused on early skin longevity. We combine science-backed skincare, thoughtful routines, and a strong consumer-first approach to build products and experiences designed for long-term skin health.

The Role

We're looking for a highly analytical, technically skilled Revenue Operations & Data Analyst to help strengthen Skyne's revenue infrastructure, optimize sales operations, and support data-driven business growth.
You'll work closely with the founder and leadership team to build reporting systems, analyze revenue performance, improve operational efficiency, and develop scalable processes across our growing business.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex business problems, building efficient systems, and translating insights into measurable business outcomes.
This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

What You'll Own

Build and maintain revenue reporting systems, dashboards, and business intelligence tools across multiple sales channels.
Analyze revenue performance, sales trends, customer acquisition, and business growth metrics.
Develop and optimize sales pipeline tracking, lead management, and revenue forecasting processes.
Support wholesale and retail expansion through account performance analysis, sales reporting, and pipeline management.
Build automated reporting workflows to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes.
Develop financial and analytical models to evaluate revenue opportunities, pricing, margins, and profitability.
Integrate data from CRM platforms, sales systems, and other business tools to create reliable reporting infrastructure.
Analyze customer behavior, purchasing patterns, and retention metrics to identify growth opportunities.
Monitor key performance indicators, including revenue growth, customer acquisition costs, sales conversion rates, and customer lifetime value.
Identify gaps and inefficiencies across sales operations and recommend process improvements.
Collaborate with business development, marketing, and leadership teams to improve reporting accuracy and operational visibility.
Support strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews through data-driven insights.
Build scalable data processes and operational systems to support Skyne's long-term expansion.

What We're Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in revenue operations, business analytics, data analytics, sales operations, or a related field.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including advanced formulas, data modeling, and reporting.
Hands-on experience with SQL and data visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
Experience working with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of revenue metrics, sales funnels, forecasting, and business performance analysis.
Experience building dashboards, automating reports, and improving data workflows.
Familiarity with Python, APIs, data integrations, or workflow automation tools is a strong plus.
Ability to work with large datasets, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
Experience with consumer brands, beauty, skincare, wellness, or CPG is preferred.
Experience in startups, high-growth businesses, or cross-functional analytical roles is a plus.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving startup environment with meaningful ownership.

Compensation

$100,000 to $115,000 annual base salary, with opportunities for performance-based growth.

Why Skyne

You'll have the opportunity to help build the revenue operations and analytics infrastructure of an emerging K-beauty brand while working directly with the founder and leadership team.
Your work will influence revenue strategy, operational efficiency, business expansion, and key decisions across the company.
We're looking for someone who wants to do more than analyze spreadsheets and produce reports. We want someone who can build systems, connect data across the business, identify opportunities, and help create a more efficient and scalable organization.

new_jobs.description:
Food & Beverage Business Analyst SeaWorld is a world-renowned leader in the themed-park and entertainment industry. Our success is built on a passion for caring for animals and a dedication to delivering positive, memorable experiences to people from around the world. We're always seeking exceptionally skilled and knowledgeable individuals to join our team. Reporting to the Regional Director of Food & Beverage, The Food & Beverage Business Analyst works directly with the Vice President of Food & Beverage, Park F&B Directors, and operational teams to identify opportunities, implement initiatives, and support park operations. The role builds strong relationships while supporting pricing strategies, technology, inventory management, and revenue-generating programs such as souvenir cups, popcorn buckets, and other branded F&B products. The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, organized, and service-oriented, with a passion for helping operators succeed and enhancing the guest experience. Key Responsibilities Park Collaboration & Operational Support

Build strong relationships with the Vice President of Food & Beverage, Park Directors, and operational teams. Serve as a responsive support partner to parks, assisting with operational needs, business initiatives, and problem-solving. Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, and Technology teams to execute projects. Maintain regular communication and follow-through with park leadership.

Revenue Growth & Product Innovation

Partner with park operators to identify new revenue opportunities and innovative F&B offerings. Support development and launch of souvenir cups, collectible popcorn buckets, specialty drinkware, and other branded vessels. Research industry trends and guest preferences to recommend new products and promotions. Evaluate product costs, pricing, margins, and sales performance; identify upselling, bundling, and seasonal promotion opportunities.

Inventory Management

Work with parks, Procurement, and Warehouse teams to maintain appropriate inventory levels of souvenir vessels and promotional products. Monitor inventory, sales trends, and replenishment needs to minimize shortages and excess stock. Support forecasting and inventory planning for seasonal events and new launches. Identify slow-moving inventory and recommend strategies to improve sell-through.

Pricing, Technology & Program Execution

Maintain accurate F&B pricing across POS systems, kiosks, mobile ordering, and digital menus. Perform ongoing POS maintenance, including menu item setup, configuration changes, pricing updates, and system accuracy checks across park locations. Coordinate and execute POS updates with park operators and Technology teams, validating changes before launch and resolving issues promptly. Establish, document, and reinforce POS best practices to promote consistent menu configuration, transaction accuracy, operational efficiency, and guest experience. Support pricing strategies through cost analysis, margin evaluation, and competitive benchmarking. Assist with technology implementations, system testing, troubleshooting, and operational improvements. Coordinate seasonal events, limited-time offerings, and product launches with park leadership and cross-functional teams. Ensure timely execution, operational readiness, and follow-through.

Analytics & Business Performance

Analyze sales trends, product performance, pricing effectiveness, and revenue opportunities. Develop reports and dashboards to support business decisions and track initiative performance. Recommend improvements to revenue, profitability, inventory efficiency, and guest satisfaction. Prepare regular performance updates for regional and park leadership.

Qualifications Required

Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Hospitality Management, Finance, or related field. 1–3 years of experience in business analytics, operations, hospitality, retail, or F&B. Strong Excel and data analysis skills. Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills. Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Preferred

Experience in multi-unit restaurant, theme park, or hospitality operations. Familiarity with POS systems, pricing platforms, and inventory management. Experience with new product launches, promotions, or revenue initiatives. Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.

Key Competencies Relationship building and collaboration

Operational support
Revenue innovation
Analytical thinking

The analyst must be proactive, responsive, collaborative, and committed to practical solutions that improve operational performance and drive revenue growth. new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Equans is looking for a Project Manager to join our team in London. This is a full-time, 12 month FTC role. On offer is a competitive salary, company vehicle, bonus and benefits package.

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to be responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery of multiple construction and M&E projects across secure and operational client sites throughout London.

Responsible for managing projects ranging from £20,000 to £3,000,000, ensuring safe, compliant, commercially robust, and high‑quality delivery across live operational environments for the Ministry of Justice (MoJ) and His Majesty’s Courts and Tribunals Service (HMCTS).

The role requires full lifecycle ownership, from client brief development and feasibility, through design and delivery, to handover and defects management.

What will you deliver?

Impact

Act as a trusted advisor to clients, defining project requirements, developing Employer's Requirements, and coordinating consultants, designers, specialists, and subcontractors to deliver successful project outcomes.
Lead projects end-to-end, ensuring compliance with CDM regulations, EQUANS policies, customer requirements, agreed payment schedules, and effective stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle.
Drive project delivery through innovative problem-solving, risk mitigation, accurate documentation, and regular reporting on progress, status, and financial performance.

Complexity

Develop and manage the full project scope, programme, budget, profitability, and risk profile, ensuring successful outcomes aligned with business objectives.
Collaborate with commercial teams on compliant tender processes and proactively identify, manage, and mitigate statutory, commercial, and delivery risks.
Ensure projects are completed, commissioned, handed over, and maintained in line with SHEQ standards, compliance requirements, and agreed timescales.

Building Relationships

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, customers, site teams, supply chain partners, and internal support functions to enable effective project delivery.

Commercial Awareness

Maintain oversight of project costs, revenue, margins, subcontractor agreements, and commercial performance, ensuring all activities comply with company policies and contractual requirements.
Ensure projects remain commercially viable and deliver agreed financial objectives.

What can we offer you?

On offer is a competitive salary, bonus and benefit package, which includes;
25 days annual leave (+ public holidays)
Life Cover equivalent to 2 times annual salary
Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
Gym membership discounts 
Cycle to work scheme 
Holiday purchase scheme
2 corporate social responsibility days per year
Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes
Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme
Access to our growing employee networks
24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

Who are you?
Proven Project Management experience in an M&E, FM, or construction environment.
End to end project management experience being responsible for development through to completion.
 Proficient in applying the RIBA Plan of Work framework to structure, coordinate and manage project stages from concept to completion.

Qualifications:

CDM awareness
Recognised technical qualification (or considerable experience 5years>) in management, construction, M&E or similar.
Business standard of written and verbal literacy and numeracy.

Desirable
NEBOSH
IOSH Managing Safely and/or SMSTS.
Recognised qualification in Project Management

Who are we?

In the UK & Ireland, Equans is a provider of sustainable facilities management and regeneration, and cutting-edge energy and digital services. Our 15,000 employees combine these activities to deliver decarbonisation across the built environment and help businesses, communities, public sector organisations and government to accelerate the transition to a low carbon, resilient world. Globally, Equans is a world leader in the energy and services sector with operations in 20 countries, 90,000 employees working on 5 continents and a turnover of 19.2 billion euros in 2024. Equans is a subsidiary of the Bouygues group.  

What's next?

If this role is of interest to you, please click below to register, apply, and track your progress! A member of our Resourcing Team will review your application and be in touch.

At Equans, we’re committed to building a diverse, respectful and inclusive workplace that truly reflects the communities and markets we serve.
Joining Equans means being part of a culture where every voice is valued, supported by vibrant employee led networks championing inclusion and diversity across gender, ethnicity, disability, LGBTQ+, veterans, parents, and young professionals.
Guided by our core values, we foster a culture of respect, integrity, collaboration, and excellence - empowering our people to deliver outstanding results and be their authentic selves every day. Our approach means we welcome candidates with transferable skills who may not meet every specific requirement, and where possible we support flexible working arrangements and reasonable adjustments to enable success.
For this role, you must have evidence of the right to work in the UK. Certain roles may require applicants to undergo a Disclosure check or security vetting, as noted in the role requirements. A criminal record will not necessarily be a barrier to obtaining a position with us.
